title: 第7章 吃了饭能继续帮为师恢复修为么第8章 苏婉卿的顾虑
slug: 师尊修为尽失后宠妻系统来了
content_zh:
第7章吃了饭，能继续帮为师恢复修为么？昔日问鼎天下，以最年轻的六境巅峰剑修身份，为世人所知。
所见之人，无不心生崇敬，大加赞赏。
如今，时过境迁，修为尽失，如同墙头草一般被人遗弃。
苏婉卿的内心是崩溃的，绝望的，因为尝试过，根本没有机会。
可没想到，竟是在楚宁身上找到了机会，他的修为能恢复。
且，如今是被楚宁这样的弟子护着的......
内心感慨何止万千，便是真情流露。
若是她仍能再找回修为，让她为弟子忘死拼杀，她都愿意。
此刻，楚宁洞府之内。
贡献点又刷新一波。
贡献值余额，现在有五千。
这些贡献点，能做的事情相当的重要了。
但楚宁想到了一件事情。
“帮我兑换两张能随时跑路的符箓，只需要能免除圣人修士追杀就行，不需要太好的。”
叮！已为宿主兑换梭空符x2，宿主动用此符箓，可任意传送十万里之外的区域，且传送过程不受任何控制阻拦、不受任何伤害
已消耗贡献点：2000
贡献点余额：4000
2000贡献点，还是霸体加无敌的传送，保命利器了。
如今，在太玄宗还有事情要做。
这口气，他不光是为苏婉卿出的，同样是为自己！

收下符箓，准备晚一些时候给苏婉卿拿上一张。
而此刻，楚宁也拿出了苏婉卿给他的储物戒指。
如今储物戒已经没了任何神识阻拦，可以随意取出其内的法宝。
楚宁神识向内看去，陡然一愣。
光是灵石，就有不下几百万的数量！
各种品级的丹药，药草，防具，法器，玲琅满目！
差点没让楚宁下巴都掉下来。
苏婉卿说给就给了？
只靠着这些，苏婉卿其实就能在未来过上不错的日子。
如今楚宁最需要的也是这个。
他眼神复杂，望了眼苏婉卿洞府的方向。
滴水之恩，自当涌泉相报，师尊只管放心，您的修为，弟子会帮忙找回来！
没有丝毫犹豫，取出一部分灵石，立刻动用吞天魔功炼化！
魔功，在名门正派之内，是被严厉禁制的。
他当然不可能让外人发现。
所以他还准备搞一本比较合适的功法。
毕竟吞天魔功只是用来修行的，飘渺剑术需要修行的时间太长了，楚宁也懒得修行这东西。
长春不灭诀属于恢复类技能，如今修行技能有了，恢复也有了，就要找一本合适出手的，霸道至极的功法！
但眼下，仍是修行。
吞天魔功对于修为提升的速度几乎可怕。

但修为提升的快，五脏六腑必然受损，甚至动摇经脉，但长春不灭决的长春之意，可以完美弥补这一天。
疯狂吸收灵气，此刻他的周身不断的析出腥臭杂质。
这是天地灵气和自身灵气交融，帮助楚宁体内排出杂质的手段！
一境，灵动，感悟天地灵气，自身于天地交融，彻底相合，便是一境巅峰境界！
当察觉到修为达到瓶颈之后，他立刻催动长生不灭，开始修复自身伤势。
content_en:
Chapter 7: After eating, can you continue to help my master recover his cultivation? In the past, he aspired to be the world leader and was known to the world as the youngest swordsman at the peak of the Sixth Realm.
Everyone who saw it was filled with reverence and praise.
Nowadays, time has passed, all cultivation has been lost, and he is abandoned like grass on the wall.
Su Wanqing's heart was broken and desperate, because she had tried, but there was no chance.
Unexpectedly, he found an opportunity in Chu Ning and his cultivation level could be restored.
Moreover, now he is protected by a disciple like Chu Ning...
There are so many emotions in my heart, and my true feelings are revealed.
If she could still find her cultivation again, she would be willing to risk her life for her disciples.
At this moment, inside Chu Ning’s cave.
Contribution points are refreshed again.
The contribution value balance is now five thousand.
What these contribution points can do is quite important.
But Chu Ning thought of something.
"Help me exchange for two talismans that can run away at any time. They just need to be able to avoid being chased by saints and monks. They don't need to be too good."
Ding! The host has been redeemed for Shuang Kong Talisman
Contribution points consumed: 2000
Contribution point balance: 4000
With 2000 contribution points, it still has a powerful body and invincible teleportation, which is a life-saving weapon.
Today, there is still something to do in Taixuanzong.
He said this tone not only for Su Wanqing, but also for himself!
Receive the talisman and prepare to get one for Su Wanqing later.
At this moment, Chu Ning also took out the storage ring Su Wanqing gave him.
Now the storage ring no longer has any spiritual obstruction, and the magic weapon inside can be taken out at will.
Chu Ning's consciousness looked inside and was suddenly startled.
The number of spiritual stones alone is no less than several million!
Various grades of elixirs, medicinal herbs, armors, and magic weapons are all dazzling!
Chu Ning's jaw almost dropped.
Did Su Wanqing just give it to her?
Just relying on these, Su Wanqing can actually live a good life in the future.
What Chu Ning needs most now is this.
He looked in the direction of Su Wanqing's cave with complicated eyes.
The kindness of a drop of water should be repaid by a spring of water. Master, just rest assured that your cultivation will be helped by the disciples!
Without any hesitation, he took out part of the spirit stone and immediately used the Heaven-Swallowing Demon Technique to refine it!
Demonic skills are strictly prohibited within the famous and decent sects.
Of course he couldn't let outsiders find out.
So he was also planning to develop a more suitable exercise book.
After all, the Heaven Swallowing Demon Technique is only for practice. The Piaomiao Sword Technique takes too long to practice, and Chu Ning is too lazy to practice it.
Changchun Immortal Technique is a recovery skill. Now that we have cultivation skills and recovery skills, we need to find a suitable and extremely domineering skill!
But for now, it’s still practice.
The speed at which the Heaven-Swallowing Demon Technique improves one's cultivation level is almost terrifying.
However, if the cultivation level is improved quickly, the internal organs will inevitably be damaged and even the meridians will be shaken. However, the meaning of Changchun in Changchun Immortal Jue can perfectly make up for this day.
Absorbing spiritual energy like crazy, at this moment, his whole body is constantly releasing fishy impurities.
This is a way for the aura of heaven and earth to blend with one's own aura to help Chu Ning expel impurities from his body!
In one realm, being agile, sensing the aura of heaven and earth, blending oneself with heaven and earth, and being completely integrated is the peak state of one realm!
When he realized that his cultivation had reached a bottleneck, he immediately activated Immortality and began to repair his injuries.
